open_points.subject: grant_viewer_project
open_points.text: grant_viewer_project: [BEHAVIOR] MUST give a pair whose earlier grants are all revoked a new grant, built and inserted exactly as for a pair that never had one, and MUST leave every revoked grant of the pair unchanged; it never updates or reactivates an earlier record.
open_points.other_text: grant_viewer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make its own reads and writes, wherever its other notes call for them, of the records the ViewerAccessRepository holds through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, and through its get_viewer_grant and its insert_viewer_grant.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must grant_viewer_project be allowed to read all grants for the viewer so it can establish that every earlier grant for the pair is revoked, or must the new behavior be stated only in terms of the single grant returned by get_viewer_grant?
